CustomField.description: The vendor id from records[].id. This is the correlation key for the whole payment lifecycle: it is the only identifier stable across uploadPayments, getPaymentReqStatus and getDDADailyReport, and it is also the paymentId taken by paymentRepresentment and getPmtBounceDemo. Not paymentRefNo, which comes back as a six digit suffix only and did not match what was sent.
CustomField.label: UAEDDS Payment Id
